exercise.prompt:
Make usernames for a new app. Read a first and last name on one line (there may be extra spaces and any capitals), then a four-digit birth year.
1. Print `Username:` and the first name in lowercase, then the first letter of the last name in lowercase, then the last two digits of the year. `Ada Lovelace` born `1815` gets `adal15`.
2. Print `Initials:` and the capital initials, each followed by a dot: `A.L.`
3. Print `Letters:` and how many letters the name has, without spaces.
exercise.promptHi:
Ek naye app ke liye usernames banao. Ek line mein first aur last name padho (extra spaces aur koi bhi capitals ho sakte hain), phir chaar digit ka birth year.
1. `Username:` print karo, phir first name lowercase mein, phir last name ka pehla letter lowercase mein, phir saal ke aakhri do digits. `1815` mein paida hui `Ada Lovelace` ko milta hai `adal15`.
2. `Initials:` aur capital initials print karo, har ek ke baad dot: `A.L.`
3. `Letters:` aur naam mein kitne letters hain, bina spaces ke, print karo.
exercise.starterCode: # Read the full name, then the birth year
